milestones.title: M0 Foundations
milestones.description: Repo, config, state DB, drive identification, logging, open decisions.

milestones.title: M1 Ingest
milestones.description: Phone (wired + wireless) and inbox to staging pipeline.

milestones.title: M2 Protect
milestones.description: restic SSD/HDD repositories, verification, retention, safe eject.

milestones.title: M3 Agent & UX
milestones.description: Tray agent, pending summary, drive events, load-aware consent.

milestones.title: M6 Phone-side
milestones.description: Hub-offline notice, snooze, consent replies on the phone.

labels.name: type:decision
labels.description: Open question that needs an answer

labels.name: mvp
labels.description: Part of the first usable version

issues.title: Decide: which databases to back up, native or Docker
issues.description: List the local database engines (PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite, MongoDB, SQL Server, ...) and whether each runs natively or in Docker. Drives DB-1.
ac: Engines and how they run are listed in this issue
ADR-0013 updated with the final list

issues.title: Decide: personal website integration (stack, public vs login page)
issues.description: Which stack and hosting does the personal website use? Should it show only public Healthchecks badges, or also a login-only status page fed by a pushed status.json?
ac: Stack/hosting documented
Chosen option recorded in ADR-0012

issues.title: Decide: offsite cloud copy (when, which provider)
issues.description: Now, later or never? Provider options: Backblaze B2, S3, Google Drive. Affects LTR-1.
ac: Decision recorded in ADR-0015

issues.title: Decide: reminder periods and default load thresholds
issues.description: Proposed: SSD backup reminder every 14 days, HDD every 30 days. Load thresholds: CPU > 70%, memory > 85%, disk active > 80%, sustained 30 s.
ac: Values agreed and written into config.example.yaml

issues.title: Decide: confirm Go + restic (ADR-0002) and tray-process hub (ADR-0003)
issues.description: ADR-0002 and ADR-0003 are Proposed. Confirm or change them before FND-1 starts.
ac: ADR-0002 status set to Accepted or superseded
ADR-0003 status set to Accepted or superseded

issues.title: Repo scaffold: Go module and Cobra CLI skeleton
issues.description: Create the Go module, cmd/photovault entrypoint with Cobra, internal/ package layout, and a CI workflow that builds and tests on Windows and Linux.
ac: photovault --help lists init, agent, status, sync, snooze, drives
CI builds and runs go test on windows-latest and ubuntu-latest

issues.title: Config file (config.yaml) with validation
issues.description: Config for drives (by serial), sources, DB list, staging quota, load thresholds, retention per repository and Healthchecks check names. Secrets are NOT stored here (ADR-0014).
ac: config.example.yaml committed
Invalid values give clear errors with the field path
photovault init writes a starter config

issues.title: State DB (SQLite): transfers, hashes, jobs, last-success times
issues.description: Pure-Go SQLite (modernc.org/sqlite). Tables for known files (sha256, size, source, first seen), job runs and step progress (for resume), and last success per tier.
ac: Schema migrations run on startup
Step progress survives a process kill and is resumed

issues.title: Identify drives by serial number and resolve the current mount path
issues.description: Windows: MSFT_PhysicalDisk / MSFT_Disk to partition to volume. Linux: lsblk / /dev/disk/by-id. Add a photovault drives add/list command that records a plugged-in drive's serial.
ac: Configured SSD/HDD are found by serial whatever their drive letter
Unknown drives and pendrives are ignored
Writes are refused if the serial is missing or ambiguous

issues.title: Structured logging and per-run JSON status files
issues.description: JSON logs with rotation; one status file per run with steps, durations, bytes and results. These feed the tray, dashboard and website push.
ac: Logs rotate by size
Status JSON schema documented

issues.title: Inbox to staging: SHA-256, dedupe, YYYY/MM by EXIF date, manifest
issues.description: Process files in staging/inbox: hash, skip known hashes, move into staging/phone/YYYY/MM using the EXIF capture date (fallback: mtime), write a manifest per batch. Enforce the staging quota and the system-drive free-space floor.
ac: Duplicate files are not stored twice
Name collisions with different content keep both files
Manifest CSV (path, size, sha256) is written per batch
Ingest is refused or deferred with a notification when the quota would be exceeded

issues.title: Wired phone ingest via adb
issues.description: Detect the configured phone by adb serial when plugged in, list configured folders (e.g. DCIM/Camera), pull only unknown files into the inbox, verify size after the pull.
ac: Plugging in the phone triggers ingest through the consent gate
Files already backed up are not pulled again
Works when the phone is unplugged and plugged in again mid-transfer (resume)

issues.title: Wired phone ingest via MTP (WPD) fallback
issues.description: Use the Windows Portable Devices API so ingest works without USB debugging.
ac: Ingest works with USB debugging disabled
Same dedupe/manifest behaviour as ING-2

issues.title: Hub HTTP API: /health, /request, chunked /upload with SHA-256
issues.description: LAN-only HTTP API with per-device tokens (photovault pair). /request implements the request-then-consent protocol; /upload is resumable and chunked with per-file SHA-256 verification.
ac: Unpaired devices are rejected
Upload resumes after a dropped connection
Hash mismatch is rejected and retried

issues.title: SPIKE: phone client options on S24 Ultra
issues.description: Compare Termux + Go binary + MacroDroid, a Syncthing fork in send-only mode, and a small native Android app. Judge on: surviving One UI battery optimization and the background-process killer, storage access, setup effort, and support for the consent reply (ADR-0011).
ac: Written comparison committed to docs/
Recommendation recorded as a new ADR

issues.title: Phone client: scan DCIM, track sent files, send backup request, handle reply
issues.description: Client side of the wireless flow, built with the technology chosen in ING-5.
ac: New photos lead to a backup request
Granted, deferred, slow and skipped replies are handled
Already-sent files are not re-sent

issues.title: Enforce append-only: device deletions never remove hub data
issues.description: Make sure no ingest path deletes or overwrites hub data. Add a report of files that are safely in both SSD and HDD repositories, for manual phone cleanup.
ac: Tests prove a deletion on the device leaves hub data unchanged
photovault status --safe-to-delete lists files verified in both tiers

issues.title: restic SSD repository: init, password in Credential Manager, back up staging
issues.description: Wrap a pinned restic version. Initialize the repository on the SSD (found by serial), keep the password in Windows Credential Manager, run backups of staging and parse restic --json output.
ac: Repository initialized on first run, with a prompt to save the password offline
Backup runs only when the SSD serial matches
Progress shown in the tray

issues.title: Verify after backup: restore new files and compare with the manifest
issues.description: After each SSD backup, restore that snapshot's new files to a temp folder and compare (path, size, sha256) with the manifest. Only then mark the staging batch eligible for cleanup (after the 7-day grace period).
ac: A deliberately corrupted file fails verification
Staging is never deleted before verification passes

issues.title: Replicate SSD to HDD with restic copy, plus subset check
issues.description: When both drives are present: restic copy new snapshots SSD to HDD, then restic check --read-data-subset=5% on the HDD repository.
ac: Snapshot lists match after the copy
Runs only when both serials match
Interrupted copy resumes next time

issues.title: Retention policy per repository (forget --prune)
issues.description: Apply retention from config after a successful copy to the next tier, so a snapshot is never pruned before it has been copied.
ac: SSD: 14 daily / 8 weekly / 12 monthly by default
HDD: 24 monthly + yearly by default
Prune never runs on the SSD before HDD replication succeeds

issues.title: Weekly full read-data check and monthly restore test (due items)
issues.description: Track these as due items that run at the next opportunity when the drive is present and load allows.
ac: Overdue checks appear in the pending summary
Restore test compares against stored manifests and records the result

issues.title: Flush and safe-eject drives, then show a safe-to-unplug notification
issues.description: When all steps for a drive are done: flush write caches, eject the volume, and notify the user it's safe to unplug.
ac: Notification only after the eject succeeds
If the eject fails (file in use), the user is told which process holds it

issues.title: Resume after shutdown or unplug partway through
issues.description: Every step stores its progress so an interrupted session continues cleanly next time.
ac: Killing the agent mid-backup leaves repositories consistent (restic check passes)
The next session continues from the stored step

issues.title: Tray agent started at logon with status icon colours
issues.description: photovault agent runs as a logon-time user process (Task Scheduler task, hidden window) with a tray icon: green all backed up, yellow pending, blue running, red failed. Menu: Show details, Run now, Open logs, Quit.
ac: photovault agent install registers the logon task without admin rights
Icon colour reflects state

issues.title: Pending-work summary on startup: hover text and startup toast
issues.description: On start, work out what's pending: files in staging not on the SSD, SSD snapshots not on the HDD, days since the last DB dump, overdue checks. Show this as a toast and in the tray tooltip.
ac: Toast lists what's pending and which drives to plug in
Tooltip updates live

issues.title: React to drive arrival and run the steps those drives allow
issues.description: Subscribe to volume-arrival events, match serials, and run SSD-only or SSD+HDD steps through the consent gate.
ac: Plugging in the SSD only runs staging to SSD
Plugging in the HDD later continues with SSD to HDD
Unknown drives are ignored

issues.title: Load monitor: CPU, memory, per-disk activity, battery, fullscreen, top processes
issues.description: Sample load over a window (default 30 s). Per-disk active time and queue length for source/target disks, battery state, fullscreen app detection, and the top 3 processes by CPU, memory and disk.
ac: Values match Task Manager within a reasonable margin
Sampling overhead below 1% CPU

issues.title: Consent gate for every automatic job
issues.description: Below thresholds: start automatically (unless always_ask). Above: notification with load, top processes and buttons Back up now / Back up slowly / When idle / In 1 hour / Skip. No answer within the timeout counts as When idle.
ac: Applies to phone requests, drive-arrival jobs, DB dumps and full checks
When idle starts after load stays below thresholds for N minutes
The decision is returned to remote clients

issues.title: SPIKE: Windows toast notifications with action buttons from Go
issues.description: Toast action buttons need an AUMID (Start Menu shortcut) and protocol or COM activation. Prove the button click reaches the running agent. Fallback: a small dialog opened from the tray.
ac: Proof of concept: a button click reaches the agent process
Approach recorded in an ADR

issues.title: Back up slowly mode: low CPU/IO priority and bandwidth limit
issues.description: Run restic and transfers at below-normal CPU priority and low I/O priority, with --limit-* options and transfer caps.
ac: Foreground apps stay responsive during a slow-mode backup (measured)

issues.title: Local dashboard: history, drive usage, SMART, verification results
issues.description: A local web page or window opened from the tray, served on localhost only.
ac: Bound to 127.0.0.1 only
Shows the last 30 runs and per-tier status

issues.title: DB dump adapters (pg_dump, mysqldump, sqlite .backup, mongodump), Docker-aware
issues.description: Dump the configured databases into staging/db/<date>/ using native tools, via docker exec when containerized. Dumps are a local-only step that can run at agent start.
ac: Each configured engine produces a consistent dump
Dumps get hashed into the manifest
Credentials are read from the credential store, not config

issues.title: Restore test for DB dumps
issues.description: Periodically load a dump into a throwaway instance (or check the dump file is valid) to prove it can be restored.
ac: Monthly due item
Result shown in status

issues.title: Healthchecks.io pings per job, with reminder periods
issues.description: Ping /start, success and /fail (with a sanitized reason) for ssd-backup and hdd-backup checks. Ping URLs are stored as secrets.
ac: Missing a period triggers a Healthchecks alert
Failure bodies contain no paths, filenames or serials

issues.title: SMART health via smartctl, warn on worsening values
issues.description: Read SMART attributes for the SSD and HDD when present; store history; warn on reallocated/pending sectors, wear level or temperature trends.
ac: Warnings appear in the tray and status
History is stored per drive serial

issues.title: Push sanitized status.json to the personal website (outbound only)
issues.description: At the end of each session, upload a sanitized status file to the website. The site never connects back to the PC.
ac: Payload contains only last-success times, sizes and health flags
Upload credentials stored in the credential store

issues.title: Website status page or Healthchecks badges
issues.description: Public badges and/or a login-only status page, depending on Q-2.
ac: Nothing sensitive is visible publicly

issues.title: Phone: hub-offline detection with a turn-on-PC notification
issues.description: From blueprint v0: if the hub is unreachable and N new photos are waiting, notify the user to turn on the PC.
ac: Notification shows the count of pending photos
At most one notification per configurable interval

issues.title: Phone: snooze and active hours
issues.description: From blueprint v0: photovault snooze <duration>, and active hours outside which no notifications are shown.
ac: Snooze survives a phone reboot
No notifications outside active hours

issues.title: Phone: show the hub's consent decision
issues.description: Show started / deferred (until when) / slow / skipped on the phone.
ac: A deferred backup starts automatically when the hub grants it

issues.title: GoReleaser and GitHub Actions on tag (windows, linux, android)
issues.description: From blueprint v0: CGO_ENABLED=0 builds for windows/amd64, linux/amd64, android/arm64, published to GitHub Releases. Bundle or fetch a pinned restic version.
ac: Pushing a v* tag publishes binaries and checksums

issues.title: One-line installers (install.ps1, install.sh)
issues.description: Installers that need no admin rights: download the release, verify the checksum, install to the user folder, register the logon task.
ac: Works on a clean Windows user account without admin rights

issues.title: Offsite copy to cloud with restic copy
issues.description: Disaster copy that closes the 3-2-1 gap.
ac: Offsite repository receives snapshots and passes check

issues.title: Cloud overflow with a hard GB quota while the hub is offline
issues.description: From blueprint v0. Temporary, client-side-encrypted holding area; emptied once the hub ingests the files.
ac: Quota never exceeded
Files removed from the cloud after verified ingest

issues.title: Laptops as clients
issues.description: From blueprint v0: Windows/Linux laptops push folders to the hub.
ac: Same request/consent flow as the phone

issues.title: Tailscale for roaming clients
issues.description: Optional transport so clients reach the hub away from home while it's on.
ac: Hub URL can be a MagicDNS name

issues.title: Wake-on-LAN sent from the phone
issues.description: Only useful if the drives stay connected; no always-on node needed, since the phone can send the magic packet on the LAN.
ac: Documented when it's useful

issues.title: Tailscale node-online trigger
issues.description: From blueprint v0. Likely unnecessary because the agent already acts at logon; kept for the record.
ac: Re-evaluate per ADR-0016
